description: This Java class implements a ScriptEventHandler that uses the javax.script API (JSR-223) to execute scripts or script functions in response to web events. It manages script context setup, handles script execution, and processes results or errors, integrating with the OFBiz framework's web request handling.

classes.name: ScriptEventHandler
classes.description: A final class that handles web events by executing scripts via the javax.script API, managing script context, and processing results or errors.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the event handler with the servlet context. Currently a no-op.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Executes a script or script function based on the provided event and request, setting up the script context with request/session data, handling script execution, and processing the result or errors.
